limits: Only the three named base document rows may retain verified base Git bytes when they differ from B; actual rows are counted and are not B-current source claims.
Named generated execution wrappers are separately proved by exact bytes in committed B evidence archives; they are absent from B source paths and are never counted as B-current sources.

Earlier failed compiler, build, and tooling attempts remain historical evidence. Platform01 and comparison01 source snapshots are bound as historical observations without changing their acquisition or failure status.

The four Any/DataSize capture-specific source proofs are retained explicitly and now also belong to the complete platform-wrapper snapshot. Each requires actual B mode/OID/framed-blob SHA/size equality; no source drift is allowed.
Original publication and checkpoint assembly process stdout/stderr, exit codes and source bookends are preserved in this C evidence archive. Any earlier failed preflight retains its actual status.
Source binding does not rerun evaluators, builds or tests and does not establish full API, whole M2 or performance compatibility.
binding_report.method: Actual base, pinned submodule and B tree OIDs/modes; SHA-1-framed Git blob reads and raw SHA-256/size; copied source bytes, required report controls and B archive members reread.
